# Jin AI

> Make every employee your best AI user. Keep confidential data in, see how each role uses AI, and hand the best harnesses to colleagues and successors.

Status: Building. Last updated: 2026-10-19.
The workspace beta is live. Company features are being built, starting with Claude Code. Companies start with a paid pilot.

Live means available now. Building means active development. Next means intended next work. Never present Building or Next as shipped. The Human page at https://jinai.md/ is the sole canonical product page. Agent-facing formats are derivatives generated from the structured JSON fact source.

For AI-forward companies.

## AI harness

An AI harness is the instructions, skills, memory and connected tools around an AI agent that make it work for a role.

- [How is this different from banning AI tools?](https://jinai.md/agent/#how-is-this-different-from-banning-ai-tools): Banning AI tools also removes the harnesses that work. Jin AI keeps confidential data in and lets the company reuse what works.

## Problem

AI spread fast. Has everything else kept up?

- When someone leaves, do their agents keep working?: When the person who built them leaves, their agents lose the context they ran on.
- Can a successor pick up where they left off?: The output gets handed over. The context, rules and judgment behind it do not.
- Does your best AI practice reach every team?: One team finds a workflow that works. The other teams never see it.
- Is company work flowing into personal AI?: Your heaviest AI users already run personal AI, and work context ends up there.

## Solution (Building)

- Connect once: Connect your usual AI tools once, through MCP.
- See every part by type: Skills, prompts, memory and MCP settings, sorted by type.
- See what each team uses most: See which harnesses each department uses most.
- Separate personal from company: Keep what came from personal AI apart from parts that hold confidential company context.
- Control approved AI tools: Let people use only the tools you approve. For example: Claude Code for developers only, your company policy in Copilot, and only non-confidential parts in ChatGPT.

## How it works and status

- Workspace beta (Live)
- Connect once (Building): Jin AI connects to your AI tools through MCP. Claude Code first.
- See every harness by category (Building): Skills, instructions, memory and MCP settings, sorted for each person.
- See it by role (Next): Which harnesses each role uses, and how often.
- Decide what can move (Next): Parts marked confidential connect only to the AI tools you approve.

## Your company's context stays yours

- Each company's context is kept separate.
- Jin AI never records your screen.
- Jin AI itself never trains on your data.
